title: Townsend Brown takes crash material from Harvard
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Townsend Brown takes crash material from Harvard, about late 1950s at Harvard, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And Townsend Brown walks in to to Harvard, flashes his credentials, and takes the material.
in 1958 in Hartford, Connecticut that Michael Swords documents, fascinating.
tellings.difference: Gives the year as 1958, names Michael Swords as the one who documented it, and mentions Project Moon Watch and Blue Book.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Townsend Brown taking material from the late-1950s Hartford crash, with the same people credited (Friend, Hynek).

as_told.title: Townsend Brown takes material from the 1958 Hartford crash
